verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently verify identity, acquisition route, cost, CaC availability, and documented mechanics. Preserve unsupported stamina, probability, and damage fields as null.
research_scope: Mach Punch — Strike Super / Burter acquisition research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository research coverage with Xenoverse 2-specific documentation, an indexed Xenoverse 2 skill guide, and independent acquisition/mechanics references.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Mach Punch was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Mach Punch is a Strike Super Skill used by Burter in Xenoverse 2.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Mach Punch is obtained as a random reward from Parallel Quest 19 — Fierce Battle! Ginyu Force. The Future Warrior can also combine Mach Punch with Mach Kick to perform Space Mach Attack.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the reviewed sources establish PQ19 as the reward route but do not establish that an Ultimate Finish is mandatory for Mach Punch.
verification_audit.cost_policy: Mach Punch is documented as a 100-Ki Strike Super. Stamina cost and exact canonical damage are left null.

records.name: Mach Punch
records.character_source: Burter / Captain Ginyu customizable partner / Jiren customizable partner
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 19 — Fierce Battle! Ginyu Force
records.skill_description: A high-speed rush of punches that charges briefly before dashing to the opponent and unleashing the punch sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: Mach Punch is one half of Burter's Space Mach Attack combination. Mach Kick can transition into Mach Punch, while Mach Punch can transition into compatible follow-up attacks. Exact timing, tracking, and damage values vary with version and setup and are not promoted as canonical numeric data.
records.acquisition_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reward guide places Mach Punch at PQ19. Independent Dragon Ball documentation identifies PQ19 as the Future Warrior's random-reward route. Later updates allow compatible partner customization for Captain Ginyu and Jiren.
records.pve_notes: PQ19 farming is required for the documented Future Warrior route; exact drop probability and Ultimate Finish dependency remain unresolved.
records.pvp_notes: The move has a brief startup followed by a rapid multi-hit punch rush and can participate in the Space Mach Attack chain. Detailed frame and matchup claims remain version-sensitive.
